description.html: The decorative skull is an eye-catching addition to a terrarium or aquarium that combines visual appeal with the practical function of a hide. Animals use it as a shelter while resting or in stressful situations.
Made from safe material, suitable for all reptiles, amphibians and fish. Easy to clean and maintain. Available in a larger size for bigger animals.
Call us or message us on WhatsApp to order. Courier delivery across Serbia, free pickup in Novi Sad.
